```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library (tidyverse)
library(mnsentinellakes)

```

```{r load data}

setwd("G:/My Drive/Research/beaches/data")

beachlist <- read.csv("BeachList.csv") %>%
  filter(!is.na(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(DOW = fixlakeid(DOW))

dowlist <- unique(beachlist$DOW)

```

```{r load ts6}

setwd("G:/My Drive/Research/watersheds")

secchi <- read.csv("Timeseries_v6_ALLDOW.csv") %>%
  mutate(DOW = fixlakeid(DOW)) %>%
  filter(DOW %in% dowlist) %>%
  filter(parameter == "secchi.m") %>%
  mutate(date = as.POSIXct(sampleDate)) %>%
  filter(date > "2000-01-01")

  
```

```{r save data}

setwd("G:/My Drive/Research/beaches/data")

write.csv(secchi, "./other_variables/clarity/secchi_from_ts6.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
